dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000r0yd](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000r0yd) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 69.344 depth occurred on Aug 15 2025 107km E of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 52.9231 longitude 159.6077. It impacted 183 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
